<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacation Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive request (immediate supervisor)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRequest" name="Approve or reject request (supervisor)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestOutcome" name="Request approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRequest" name="Return rejected request to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReasons" name="Review rejection reasons (employee)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_ReviewReasons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewReasons_EndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejection reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewReasons_EndRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateNotification" name="Generate notification for Human Resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Complete management procedures (Human Resources Representative)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_EndApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_EndApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Register" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReturnRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_GenerateNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_ReviewReasons" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewReasons_EndRejected" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notification_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_EndApproved" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules.situation: the description states that an item is registered before another participant handles it

rules.instruction: When the description states that an item is submitted and separately registered before it is handled by another participant: Model submission and registration as distinct activities, in the stated order, before the subsequent handling activity.
rules.situation: the description states that an item is submitted and separately registered before it is handled by another participant

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states an action performed by a participant before subsequent process work: Model that action as a BPMN activity and include it in the sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description states that an action has been completed before a subsequent process step, even if it is not phrased as an instruction

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states a specific action or outcome for a modeled element
